summaryDeep: Your identities and goals cooperate without much effort. You back each other's direction naturally. Lean on how naturally you line up and build something together.
tension: The only real challenge is assuming the connection will take care of itself. It is easy to enjoy how comfortable things feel and never move beyond that.
advice: Make something of the ease. Stay curious about each other, show up when it matters, and give the connection somewhere to grow. The natural fit is valuable, but it becomes stronger when you actively build on it.
